title: capability auto-discovery grading policy (conservative default)
note: Evidence level is derived from pytest outcomes by data, not code branches. `passed` may reach the level a test declares; anything else is capped at WITHHELD. `undeclared_passed_level` keeps silent tests from claiming REAL, and `require_anchors_for` keeps un-anchored passing tests from claiming REAL. Edit this file to change the policy for an experiment; the digest of whatever policy was applied is stored in the ledger (capability_discovery ledger.doc.policy_digest) and in every grade, so a level can always be traced back to the rules that produced it.
